flagged.title: Context: Race, Jealousy & Jacobean England
flagged.reason: The video repeatedly tells students that context is assessed under AO4 on the Shakespeare paper and models embedded context for non-existent marks, when context is not assessed at all and AO4 is assessed for technical writing accuracy.

mark_affecting.quote: Now when the Eduqas examiners ask for AO4, context, they are not looking for a boring history lesson...
AO4 (Context) Understanding the Jacobean world's social, racial, and patriarchal rules to explain actions.

flagged.title: Character Analysis
flagged.reason: The video cites 'Arabian perfumes' as Othello's imagery, teaching a famous quotation from Macbeth (5.1) rather than Othello's 'Arabian trees' (5.2), which penalises students on AO1 textual accuracy.

mark_affecting.quote: Notice how all this exotic imagery: Indians, pearls, Arabian perfumes, clusters right around his death?

mark_affecting.quote: And he uses prose in his own soliloquies to reveal his cold, calculating nature.
The phrase 'honest Iago' is used over 50 times in the play.
